readme.html:
Adobe Skills for AI Coding Agents

Skills that teach AI coding agents to work with Adobe products. A skill is a folder with a SKILL.md that an agent loads when a task calls for it (agentskills.io). The skills are grouped into plugins, one per product or job, and are installed straight from the main branch of this repository.

Install

Pick plugins from the table below. The first column is the name to install.

Claude Code

/plugin marketplace add adobe/skills
/plugin install aem-edge-delivery-services@adobe-skills

GitHub Copilot CLI

Copilot takes the marketplace from .claude-plugin/marketplace.json, so the same marketplace works there. Of each plugin it reads the root plugin.json, the Agent Plugins manifest, not .claude-plugin/plugin.json: it loads skills only from the folders directly under skills/, MCP servers from mcp.json and hooks from com.github.copilot/hooks/hooks.json. A skills list in the Claude Code manifest does not reach Copilot (verified 2026-11-15 with Copilot CLI 1.0.112, the aem-edge-delivery-services and adobe-for-developers plugins, and the plugin reference). Copilot in VS Code and the cloud agent pick the plugins up too.

copilot plugin marketplace add adobe/skills
copilot plugin install aem-edge-delivery-services@adobe-skills

Copilot CLI exposes a skill under its bare name, without the plugin as a prefix, so two installed plugins with a same-named skill are ambiguous there. aem-cloud-service and aem-6-5-lts share skill names: install the one that matches your runtime. Copilot CLI does not resolve plugin dependencies; install them yourself.

Google Antigravity

Antigravity installs a plugin from the URL of its directory (verified 2026-11-15 with Antigravity CLI 1.5.9). A plugin's directory is the one its link in the table below leads into: plugins/aem/edge-delivery-services for aem-edge-delivery-services.

agy plugin install https://github.com/adobe/skills/tree/main/plugins/aem/edge-delivery-services
agy plugin list

agy plugin install https://github.com/adobe/skills installs the plugins that lie directly under plugins/ in one go. The AEM, Commerce and Creative Cloud plugins lie deeper and need their own URL.

What you get this way is the skills:

  • Antigravity does not register a plugin's MCP server and does not run its hooks. See what each plugin needs.
  • It does not install the plugins a plugin depends on.
  • It loads the first 24,000 bytes of a SKILL.md, which cuts the longest skills short (#665).

agy plugin import claude copies the plugins you have installed in Claude Code. That does bring their MCP servers, but not every hook. For adobe-for-developers it brings the tools that delete Developer Console resources without the hook that asks before they run (#666).

Any agent that reads skills

npx skills add adobe/skills --list           # list the skills
npx skills add adobe/skills --skill aem-cli  # install one
npx skills add adobe/skills --all            # install all

gh extension install ai-ecoverse/gh-upskill
gh upskill adobe/skills --all

These copy skills, not plugins: an MCP server, a hook or a dependency that a plugin brings does not come with them. See what each plugin needs.

Cursor (preview)

app-builder has a Cursor manifest as the pilot for Cursor distribution. Its README has the steps.

Plugins

Plugin What it is for What it needs
adobe-analytics KPI monitoring, funnels, segment comparison and readouts in Adobe Analytics MCP server
adobe-cja The same for Customer Journey Analytics, plus dimension analysis MCP server
adobe-for-developers Search developer.adobe.com; manage Developer Console projects, credentials and I/O Events MCP server
aem-edge-delivery-services Build sites on Edge Delivery Services: blocks, content models, local development, page import Node.js. Some skills use a Figma or DA MCP server if one is connected
aem-eds-content-ops Content operations on Edge Delivery Services: audits, SEO, accessibility, metadata, sitemaps
aem-eds-personalization Section-based personalization on Edge Delivery Services: rules, a decision API, an A/B split or Adobe Target pick the fragment a section shows Node.js and Playwright for the checks; a Cloudflare edge worker is optional
aem-forms-edge-delivery-services Custom components for the Form block on Edge Delivery Services Node.js
aem-project-management Handover documentation and PDF guides for Edge Delivery Services projects Plugin hooks, which not every client runs
aem-cloud-service AEM as a Cloud Service: components, Dispatcher, workflows, migration from AEM 6.x MCP servers for Dispatcher and migration findings
aem-6-5-lts AEM 6.5 LTS and AMS: Dispatcher, workflows, replication MCP server for Dispatcher
app-builder App Builder projects: actions, UI, tests, CI/CD, Workfront UI extensions aio CLI, Node.js
commerce-app-management Scaffold and configure Adobe Commerce apps with the aio-commerce-sdk aio CLI, Node.js 22
commerce-app-migration Move a Commerce starter-kit project to App Management
commerce-app-review Review a Commerce app before submitting it to Adobe Exchange
run-workflow Run and compose Adobe Firefly workflows MCP server; enterprise account with a Firefly entitlement
semrush Competitive SEO data for any domain from Semrush MCP server; Semrush account
stardust Modernise an existing website, with or without a redesign, and ship it The impeccable plugin from its own marketplace; Node.js 22, Playwright
web Browser automation and page analysis for arbitrary sites Node.js 22, playwright-cli
workfront Workfront Planning solution architecture; Fusion scenario review

A plugin's skills are the folders under its skills/ directory, and each SKILL.md starts with what the skill is for. This file does not list them, so that it does not go stale: the plugin's own README does where there is one, and npx skills add adobe/skills --list prints them all.

One more plugin is in this repository but not in its marketplace: adobe-for-creativity, Adobe Creative Cloud tools for images, design and video. It is installed from the plugin directory of the Claude desktop app; see the next section for why.

MCP servers and the clients they work with

Some plugins are skills on top of an MCP server. Whether such a plugin works depends on the server and on the agent you use, the MCP client, and not every pairing works today.

Plugin MCP server What the client has to do Known limits
adobe-for-creativity https://adobe-creativity.adobe.io/mcp, registered by the plugin Be the Claude desktop app or Claude Cowork Every other client, Claude Code CLI included, gets a bare 403, also for the OAuth discovery documents, so sign-in cannot start. There are no plans to support the CLI (#184, #225, #391)
run-workflow https://run-workflow.adobe.io/mcp, registered by the plugin Standard OAuth: discovery and the 401 challenge work Sign-in succeeds only for an enterprise account with a Firefly Services or Firefly Creative Production entitlement. A personal Adobe account signs in and is then refused (#365)
adobe-analytics, adobe-cja https://aa-mcp.adobe.io/mcp, https://cja-mcp.adobe.io/mcp Send Adobe IMS headers with every request: Authorization, x-gw-ims-org-id, x-gw-ims-user-id The plugin's .mcp.json is a template without those headers. Use a client that can add headers to an MCP server, or an OAuth proxy that injects them
adobe-for-developers https://adp-connector.adobe.io/mcp, registered by the plugin Open the Adobe IMS sign-in on first use The destructive Developer Console tools ask for approval before they run. The hook that asks even when a tool is on an allow list runs in Claude Code and Copilot CLI only. It does not run in Antigravity, also not after agy plugin import claude has brought the server there (#666)
semrush https://mcp.semrush.com/v2/mcp, which you add to your agent yourself OAuth with a redirect URI that Semrush allows. http://localhost:<port> and Claude's own callback were accepted A client whose OAuth callback is on its vendor's domain is refused at registration. The 401 carries no WWW-Authenticate header, so the client has to find the metadata at the well-known paths (details)
aem-cloud-service Dispatcher MCP, run locally with AEM_DEPLOYMENT_MODE=cloud; the AEM MCP Server for migration findings from Cloud Acceleration Manager Run a local MCP server; connect the AEM MCP Server Migration works without the AEM MCP Server, from a Best Practices Analyzer CSV
aem-6-5-lts Dispatcher MCP with AEM_DEPLOYMENT_MODE=ams Run a local MCP server #519 reports that no Dispatcher MCP for AMS is available today. Without it the Dispatcher skills can advise but not verify
aem-edge-delivery-services, workfront None of their own Nothing figma-to-content needs a Figma MCP server from your client. A DA or Workfront Planning MCP server is used when one is connected

The other plugins use no MCP server.

Two things hold for every plugin with an MCP server:

  • A plugin registers its server only in a client that installs plugins: Claude Code, Copilot CLI, the Claude desktop app. With npx skills or gh upskill you get the skills and have to add the server to your agent yourself. The same goes for agy plugin install in Antigravity.
  • These servers sign you in with Adobe IMS or the vendor's OAuth. A client without a browser at hand, such as a headless or cloud agent, cannot complete that sign-in.

What each client loads

CI installs every plugin a pull request changes into four clients, each with an empty home directory, and reports what the client then lists (the Plugin Test Drive check). With all plugins on 2026-11-15:

Client Skills MCP servers Hooks
Claude Code 2.1.322 All Registered Loaded
Codex CLI 0.169.0 All Registered Not checked: Codex has no command that lists them
Grok CLI 1.0.77 All. For aem-cloud-service and aem-6-5-lts also the skills in deeper folders, which the other clients reach only through the skill above them Registered Loaded
Antigravity CLI 1.5.9 All Not registered Not loaded

Listed is not the same as working: no client was signed in, and no hook or MCP server was called. adobe-for-creativity is not in the marketplace, so only Grok and Antigravity, which install from a directory, were given it.

Contributing

See CONTRIBUTING.md for how to add or change a skill, and AGENTS.md for the rules that catch agents out. Join #agentskills on Adobe Slack for questions.

Resources

  • agentskills.io specification
  • Claude Code plugins
  • Google Antigravity plugins
  • Vercel skills CLI
  • upskill GitHub extension
